aw26.short: Browns and near-blacks, with plum and hot accents
aw26.headline: Browns and near-blacks take over from black, lit by plum, moss and hot accents of tomato red, cobalt and mustard.
aw26.built: Read from the autumn/winter 2026 shows (January menswear, February and March womenswear) and in-store sell-in. Chocolate was the second most-worn colour on the womenswear runways after black, charcoal and pine green grew the most, and plum, moss, tomato red and mustard were the colours reviewers singled out.

ss27.short: Purple, true red and Klein blue over sun-faded neutrals
ss27.headline: Colour comes back in full: purple and lilac, head-to-toe red and Klein blue over sun-faded whites, sand and tobacco.
ss27.built: Read from the spring/summer 2027 shows (June menswear and Pitti Uomo, September womenswear) and the Première Vision February fabric fair. White rose the most on the runways; purple was the most reported colour in New York; red returned head to toe; menswear moved to butter yellow, lavender, pink and ice blue over earth tones.

aw27.short: Violet, plum and bordeaux replace black
aw27.status: Trade-fair signals; runways in February and March 2027
aw27.headline: Violet, plum and tannic bordeaux replace black, over neutrals that are no longer neutral: tinted off-blacks, mushroom beige and greyed blue.
aw27.built: Read from the September 2026 fabric and leather fairs (Première Vision, Lineapelle, Milano Unica) and carried forward from the SS27 runways. The fairs put deep violet, plums, dusty pinks and mauves at the centre, with tinted off-blacks, greyish blues, sage and waxy ochre.

ss28.short: Royal blue, turquoise and greyish mauve
ss28.status: Long-range forecast from early fair previews
ss28.headline: Blues come back strong, royal and a new turquoise, beside greyish mauve and violet, over straw and bleached linen, with an after-dark edge of inky blue and murky green.
ss28.built: A long-range Forecut forecast from the first SS28 previews: Première Vision's October 2026 colour preview (royal blue, deeper sky blue, a new turquoise, greyish mauve and a dense violet), fabric-fair womenswear previews (straw, khaki green, warm beige, peach) and a darker after-dusk summer mood. It will be updated after the February 2027 fairs.
